description: This file contains unit tests for the DataCapture plugin, focusing on initializing, enabling/disabling audio capture, and handling events related to audio clips, including socket server setup and mock IARM bus interactions.

classes.name: DataCaptureTest
classes.description: Base test fixture for DataCapture plugin tests, setting up core objects and JSONRPC handler.

classes.name: DataCaptureInitializedTest
classes.description: Derived fixture that initializes the DataCapture plugin and mocks IARM bus interactions.

classes.name: DataCaptureInitializedEnableAudioCaptureTest
classes.description: Fixture that configures mock responses for enabling audio capture and invokes the method.

classes.name: DataCaptureInitializedEnableAudioCaptureEventTest
classes.description: Further fixture that sets up event dispatching, mocking service and dispatcher interface.

methods.name: runSocket
methods.description: Sets up a UNIX socket server that writes a fixed answer to the client.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Sets up a TCP server that receives a message and sends back an HTTP response.
